_readme: Sample answer file for fdr-sddc-recovery-plan.json, consumed via Import-VCFIRAnswerFile.
Deployment uses custom vCenter placement. Appliance identity and IP configuration remain those in the existing extracted SDDC data.
This plan has no cmdlet answer-file prompts, so no cmdlet keys are required. Deployment and backup settings belong in the matching variables file.
The UI prompts for the SDDC Manager backup encryption password on first use and reuses it for upload and restore. This password is not an interactive-task answer and is not stored in this template.
